senses.gloss: c. (λίτρα) Litra, the Roman Libra, a pound; also a measure of capacity (divided into 12 unciae).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 5:11">Tosef. Ter. V, 11</cite>; Y. ib. IV, 43ᵃ <he>ל׳ קציעות וכ׳</he> a pound of figs which one pressed &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 89a:11">B. Bath. 89ᵃ</cite> if a person wishes to buy <he>ג׳ רביע ל׳</he> three quarters of a pound, he must not say, weigh for me <he>ג׳ רביעי ל׳ וכ׳</he> three quarters of a pound, each quarter separately &c.
Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ top וכמה ל׳ עבדא מאה זינין and how much is a L.? One hundred zin (v. זוּז II).

<cite ref="Nedarim 59a:8">Ned. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ בצלים</he> a Litra of onions; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לִיטְרִין</he>, <he>לִיטְרוֹת</he>, <he>לִיטְרָאוֹת</he>, <he>לִיטְרָיוֹת</he>. B. Bath. l. c. Tosef. Ter. l. c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:7">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22">Lev. R. s. 22</cite>. Y. Peah II, 20ᵃ bot.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 1:16">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 16</cite> <he>חֲצָאֵי ל׳</he> (not <he>ליטרי</he>), <he>שְׁלִישֵׁי ל׳</he>, <cite ref="T00105"><he>רְבִיעֵי</he></cite> weights of a half-pound, a third of a pound &c.—Chald. pl. <he>לִיטְרַיָּיא</he>, <he>לִיטְרִין</he>. Lev. R. l. c. <he>גוזלא … ותרתין ל׳ וכ׳</he> a pigeon on one side and two L. on the other; Gen. R. l. c.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:3:3">Y. Ned. VI, 39ᵈ</cite> top <he>ליטרי</he>, v. <cite ref="I00827"><he>טָרִיתָא</he></cite>.]
